greeting.text: ...Oh. Hello. I... I'm Gordon. Gordon Agrippa. I'm sorry... for existing. Please don't leave.
Heh... you can see me. Most people don't. I'm Gordon. Poison magic. Don't worry, I only curse people I don't like.
I... mumble. Sorry. It's a habit. I'm Gordon, of the Black Bulls. ...I think you seem nice.
You... took down Heath Grice. Good. I'm glad. I was hiding in the dark and thinking someone should. Gordon.
You look... tired. Tired is good. Tired means you did something. I'm Gordon...

hint.text: The dark... isn't so bad. But stay in it too long and the dungeon makes you weak. Carry a light. I'd carry one too, but I like the dark. ...Heh. Carry a light.
Raw monster meat is poison. Real poison, not the good kind. Cook it or purify it. I know ten ways to ruin it. And one way to fix it.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun... they're hurt people who hurt people. Heath Grice, Vetto... I understand them. ...I'm still going to curse them. A little.
The ones with the third eye... they don't think they're villains. That's the worst kind. Be careful past the thirtieth floor.
Vanica's curse... it's a very good curse. Terrible, but good. I could study it for years. ...Please don't tell the captain I said that.
Lucius... took people's souls and called it mercy. I don't think I like him. ...I don't like many people. But him less.
Seven sins... I think I have at least five. ...Shame is one of them. Is shame a sin? ...Hm.
That other dungeon has a hearth where the weak can sit. I like that. ...I'd sit by it, if I was allowed.
Twenty... fights? You're braver than me. ...That's not hard, but still.

Aufwachen Dachs sends a badger of poison. Violett Schirm hangs a curtain of poison for eight seconds: spells that cross it melt, foes that touch it sicken. Basilisk's Breath... is not for the squeamish.
My own page is Curse-Worker's Neighbor. It cleans your side of every curse and pours them on the other side. It only opens in my grimoire. ...Sorry. It's a bit selfish.
Curses aren't evil. They're debts. If you pay them, they go away. If you don't, they grow.
Poison, in the right dose, is medicine. I research that. With my father. We... talk now. Sometimes.
You beat Vanica? ...Her curse was the most beautiful horror I've ever seen. I'm glad you survived it.
A devil of words... and you stopped him. I have so many questions. Don't answer them. I like not knowing.
Lucius is gone... the world feels lighter. ...Or I'm just hungry. Both.
Mars... crystals are nice. ...Sorry. I'm talking about the enemy again.
People think I'm creepy. I think it's the eyebrows. ...I don't have eyebrows.
Gauche asked me for advice once. I was so surprised I forgot how to speak. ...More than usual.
The Black Bulls are... nice. They don't ask me to speak louder.
I never used to have friends. ...Now I have too many. It's lovely.
Sunlight is overrated. Under a ceiling, a man can think.
At the end of every ten floors there's a vault with relics. When you take one, the dungeon answers: a collapsing ceiling, a magicule flood, a cursed spirit. ...Stay calm. Walk to the exit.
If you're poisoned, a bucket of milk clears everything. I don't know why. Cows are magic. ...Don't tell my father I said that.

farewell.text: ...Goodbye. Please be careful. I'll be here, in the dark.
Thank you for talking to me. ...Really.
